description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommand for handling delete operations on feature properties within the Ditto signals command framework. It defines a class that extends an abstract modify command and provides methods for creating instances, accessing command details, and setting headers.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation class of DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommand for delete feature property commands.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl from a general Command object, casting it to DeleteFeatureProperty.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the property to be deleted.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with specified Ditto headers set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization. Returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing answers to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
